title: Day mode and night mode incorrectly share one brightness value
symptom: A comfortable daytime brightness made night mode too bright, and a comfortable night brightness made daytime reading too dim.
root_cause: Reader settings stored brightness as a single global scalar instead of maintaining per-appearance-mode state.
fix: Split brightness into independent day-mode and night-mode values.
Set more sensible defaults around 80% for day and 30% for night.
Migrated legacy single-brightness settings forward so existing users do not lose their preference.
impact: Brightness adjustments became frustrating because switching appearance mode undid the user's comfort tuning.
